Now implementing Fix 1 in the admin UI.
Now the JS: pagination state, rendering, and inline detail.
Fix 1 done. Now Fix 2 — claim distinction in model, prompt, validation, recall, UI, and tests.
Now the validation logic in cognitive.py.
Now Fix 4 — make flow pulses reliably visible with constant screen size and comet trails.
I'll run the full test suite for the final state, then write the report.
All checks pass. Writing the report.
All four fixes are complete and verified. `FIX_REPORT.md` is written; nothing committed or pushed.

**Final state**
- Tests: 135 passed, 4 skipped (the 4 skips require a disposable Neo4j); `tests/test_cognition.py` 8/8.
- Fix 1: 20/page pagination (verified "第 1 / 90 页 · 共 1788 条"), filter-change resets, inline detail inside the item — no bottom `#memory-detail`, no console errors.
- Fix 2: `Claim` enum (`user_instruction`/`user_fact`/`agent_action`), extract-v3 prompt + validator, agent actions excluded from recall; regression tests assert no assistant action is attributed to the user, and old memories default to `user_fact` with no bulk rewrite.
- Fix 3: `openclaw@alma-test` present in `/v1/agents`; only `.alma-test/home/agents/openclaw.json` changed; token never printed; plugins and `mem connect` untouched.
- Fix 4: constant-pixel 3-comet pulses on flow links only; browser frame-diff shows ~1000–1400 moved pixels per 900 ms in timeline view; glow slider still visible and functional (60% ↔ 20%), no page errors.

Modified files: `memhub/{models.py, cognitive.py, recall.py, prompts/extract.md, static/admin.html, static/admin.js, static/graph.js}` and `tests/test_cognition.py`.
